text:
Rae (Partnerships): Heads-up from Kento: HyperGrid is moving to per-10s eventing and introducing a "component" field (base, accel) on 2026-06-15. They want marketplace customers to see the same billing as before. Need ingestion + billing plan.

Omar - Marketplace: Per-10s will massively increase event volume. Do they also provide per-minute rollups?

Kento (HW Partner): We'll publish both: raw_10s stream and minute_rollup files. Rollups will have aggregation_id and currency in header.

Priya (Finance): For billing: prefer minute_rollup when present. Rule: if rollup present for minute M, ignore raw for billing dedupe; still store raw for telemetry. Need idempotency token and aggregation_id to dedupe.

Zoe (Eng): Technical plan: add columns source_granularity, aggregation_id, component_tag, partner_amount_minor. Deduper key = (partner_id, aggregation_id) if aggregation_id != null else (partner_id, raw_event_id). We'll keep raw_event_timestamp and normalize to UTC_day for entitlements.

Rae (Partnerships): How do we treat nested SKUs? A customer with reserved "hypergrid-base" should cover base events but not accel if accel is billable.

Priya (Finance): Contract rule: if component=accel and contract.accel_included=false => bill accel. Otherwise include in base SKU. We'll maintain partner_sku_map table. Add a partner flag prefer_rollup_for_billing.

Omar - Marketplace: Rounding: convert partner_amount to minor units, sum per invoice line, then apply "round half away from zero" on final invoice line. That reduces noise vs per-event rounding.

Zoe (Eng): Also add source_granularity tag so audits can trace whether line came from rollup or raw. For replay/backfills allow 7-day reconciliation window; post-window adjustments create adjustment entries with audit_reason.

Kento (HW Partner): We'll provide a 30-day mapping CSV old_sku->component tags and sample raw+rollup files to sandbox by Monday.

ingest-bot: Note: schema-change-alert for HyperGrid scheduled 2026-06-15T00:00:00Z. Monitor new_field_rate and aggregate_conflicts for 72h.

Rae (Partnerships): Thanks all. Owners: Kento provide files, Zoe PR for schema+flags, Priya update billing playbook, Omar update marketplace docs. Quick sync tomorrow 10am PT.
